name: Max-D

specialAbility.name: Maximum Overdrive
specialAbility.description: Max-D kicks into overdrive, supercharging its engine to blast past opponents at mind-blowing speed!

lore: Max-D was built by a mad scientist who wanted to create the fastest, most destructive machine ever! With its silver armor and blazing orange lightning bolts, Max-D flies higher, spins harder, and lands heavier than almost any truck alive. When you hear that engine roar, you better get out of the way!
